title: sisters_wedding_ring
display_title: I found my late sister's engagement ring in my fiancé's coat pocket
beats: I found my dead sister's engagement ring in my fiancé's coat pocket, three weeks before our wedding.
She died four years ago, before they ever met, or so he told me.
I sat with it for two days, turning it over, before I asked him straight out.
He went pale and said he bought it off a pawn shop last month, no idea whose it was.
But the inside was engraved with her initials and the date of a proposal that never happened, from a boyfriend she never named.
I still haven't told him I know exactly whose name he almost carved next to hers.
